name: Angular
description: Current Angular style guidance strongly favors feature-oriented organization over top-level code-type buckets.

rules.title: Organize application code by feature areas
rules.summary: Angular recommends subdirectories based on application features or common themes.

rules.title: Avoid top-level code-type buckets
rules.summary: Angular explicitly advises against organizing application directories primarily as components, directives and services buckets.

rules.title: Prefer one concept per file
rules.summary: Angular recommends focusing source files on a single concept.

sources.title: Style Guide • Angular
sources.notes: Current official guide recommends feature-area organization and explicitly discourages directories organized by code type such as components/directives/services.
